notes: The Glen Park Association's paper under each of its names in the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers: Glen Park Association Newsletter (1977-78), Glen Park Newspaper (1978), Glen Park Perspective (1978-80), Glen Park News (1982-2012) and one issue titled Glen Park Association (2003) - 124 items, March 1977 to December 2012. Source text is each item's hOCR search text; leaves from its hOCR page index. extra.candidate is the window number in the run's scratch merge.

coverage.remaining: Nothing in this title. Unread titles in the collection: Noe Valley Voice, The Potrero View, Richmond ReView, New Mission News, Tenderloin Times, North Mission News, the Bernal Journals, Park Bell, The Semaphore titles, The New Fillmore and the singletons (see the dossier).
coverage.note: 1,686 OCR pages; 3,511 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets (with --untyped for the title's own main streets). ocr_mentions.py kept 367 windows; 436 advertisement- or advertiser-dropped windows carrying a strong event word were added back: 803 windows read by hand by four readers. 137 candidates; 82 set aside before entry - bare occupancy of an institution with no event (most of them: library, school and church addresses in calendars and directories), repeats of one event across issues, display advertisements, a proposal never confirmed, businesses named for their proprietor, and contact addresses. 55 findings written.
